title: The Allex
description: Redesigning the POS experience and rewarding the people who run it.

sections.label: Overview
sections.heading: Connecting transactions with the people who make them happen
body: Allex was a pretty unique challenge because we weren't just building one product, we were building a brand house that had to cover two completely different things: a modern POS system for restaurant staff and a website builder for small business owners. Cyril, the founder, brought me in as the founding designer to shape the whole experience from scratch, so I had to design everything from the logos and user flows to picking the brand identity and figuring out how a checkout page should feel.

sections.label: Process
sections.heading: Looking past managers and choosing a loud color
body: When we started talking to small business owners, we noticed that most POS software completely ignores the staff actually using it, treating them like data entry clerks instead of real people. Restaurant owners were struggling to keep their servers motivated while keeping service fast, so we wanted to build something that feels rewarding for employees, not just a system for bosses. I also made a pretty opinionated call to use a vibrant red for the brand instead of the safe blues and grays you see everywhere. Restaurant floors are chaotic, and red brings that sense of urgency and energy, and it also fits the food and hospitality vibe perfectly.
bullets: Standard POS systems felt slow and rigid, and staff hated using them.
Most platforms have no way to recognize staff performance in their day-to-day screens.
We needed a parent brand that could tie a POS tool and a site builder together without looking messy.

sections.label: Result
sections.heading: Two distinct products, one coherent brand
body: We shipped Allex POS with two main interfaces: an admin dashboard for managers to track sales and a mobile app for employees to clock in, see their daily progress, and get recognized for their work. For the other side of the brand house, we built Allex Builder, which lets small business owners launch a clean, professional site with pre-built templates and a checkout flow in a few minutes without needing a developer.
bullets: A mobile employee app that turns daily performance into clear, visual milestones.
An admin dashboard that keeps business operations and team stats in one place.
A website builder with responsive, ready-to-use templates tailored for local businesses.

sections.label: Reflection
sections.heading: Start with the parent concept
body: What I really learned from this is how important it is to define the parent concept early. Deciding to frame Allex as a 'brand house' instead of just a SaaS tool made all the downstream decisions so much easier because we had a clear structure to follow. When you set the right foundations, the individual product details just fall into place naturally.
